name: Monique Willoughby
quote: Ms. Paulette is an amazing Daycare instructor/teacher, safe and clean environment , my son Noah learned how to communicate his words better because of Ms. Paulette, I was a nervous at first because Noah had never been to daycare however Ms. Paulette reassured me through actions that Noah is always safe in her care and my worries has been at eased ever since. He is now interactive with the other children learning how to share and properly play with the other children. Ms. Paulette also communicates to me when she needs to redirect Noah from making a poor choice. I would recommend Ms. Paulette to other parents in need of childcare.
